q.q: Which language is used to define the structure and content of a web page?
q.x: HTML structures web content; CSS handles presentation/styling.

q.q: Which attribute specifies the image file in the tag?
q.x: src sets the image source URL. alt provides alternative text and href is used on anchors.

q.q: Which HTML tag represents the largest heading?
q.x: <h1> is the largest heading level and <h6> the smallest.
Cascading Style Sheets control the presentation — colours, fonts, spacing and layout — of HTML documents.

q.q: Which HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
q.x: The <a> (anchor) tag creates hyperlinks: <a href="...">. <link> is used in the head for stylesheets.
